sourceTitle: Tomato Feta Grilled Zucchini and Squash
sourceText:
Tomato Feta Grilled Zucchini and Squash
By: Holly Sander
Published: Thursday, August 25, 2016 - 2:46pm

Ingredients




2 medium sized yellow squash
2 medium sized zucchini
6 ounces French Feta (made from sheep milk) or Greek feta
10 ounces cherry tomatoes
8-10 fresh basil leaves
1 tablespoon olive oil
High heat cooking spray (like canola)
Salt and pepper

Preparation

1 Cut the zucchini and squash in half. 2 Using a sharp knife cut around the inside edge of the squash. Next make horizontal slits across the squash, from one side to the other of the lengthwise cut. 3 Use a spoon to carve out the center of each zucchini and squash, so they look like little boats. Reserve the center pieces. 4 Season the zucchini and squash with salt and pepper, and dust with cooking spray. 5 Heat grill to 450 degrees and grill for 4 minutes per side. 6 Rough chop the squash meat you removed from the center of each squash and cook in olive oil, with salt and pepper, on medium-high heat for 8 minutes. Crumble the feta cheese & slice the cherry tomatoes in half and fold into the sautéed squash. Cook for 2 minutes, then spoon the mixture into the grilled zucchini “boats”. Chiffonade the basil leaves (aka cut into long thin strips), sprinkle on the zucchini boats, and serve.

About

Tomato Feta Grilled Zucchini and Squash = a simple, mouthwatering combination! Low on calories & big on flavor, these boats of goodness satisfy every time.
Please visit my blog Taste and See for more delicious recipes!
